svg.title: Map of Virginia showing the counties and cities B Safe Advisor Group serves
svg.desc: Virginia map with these counties highlighted: Loudoun, Fairfax, Arlington, Clarke, Frederick, Warren, Shenandoah, Prince William, Rappahannock, Culpeper, Fauquier, and Page. The cities of Alexandria, Falls Church, Fairfax, Manassas, Manassas Park, and Winchester are also highlighted. Ashburn in Loudoun County is marked as the office location. An enlarged inset of Northern Virginia and the northern Shenandoah Valley is shown at the upper left.

g.text: and Winchester. I also serve surrounding
